column1: # tests/release/channels.tsv — channel census of the release scripts (round 6). One row per external command
# invocation found by tests/release/channel_census.py; checked by tests/release/test_channel_census.sh.
# Columns (closed vocabulary in channel_census.py): script, command, key (sha256/8 of the line), argv, env, stdin,
# files, bound, note. env 'allowlist' = the environment rc_env_clean builds from the allow-list of rc_env_lockdown
# (round 7: built positively by a clean re-execution, so no inherited entry reaches a child); 'empty' = no
# environment at all; 'net-allowlist' (round 11) = the environment rc_net gives a network child: the fixed
# network allow-list of redact_cut.sh, value-checked, never RELEASE_ENV_KEEP (the lint checks that exactly the
# rows reached through rc_net, nt or net carry it). Only three rows may carry the token: the publisher's curl
# (stdin token-config), the tag script's publisher call (env allowlist+token) and the re-execution of rc_env_clean (stdin state-pipe: fd 9).
# Rows with command '-' are lines that name a secret variable without running a command (secret-ref).
# A changed script line makes its row stale: re-run 'channel_census.py list', re-classify the row by hand.
